support.title: Have a question? We are here

description.one: If you have questions or want to learn more about my classes, reach out in any way that is convenient for you.

1.question: Is Frame Up suitable if I have never danced before?
1.answer: Yes, this style is beginner-friendly. In the offline beginner group, we move step by step and focus on technique, body flow, and confidence. You can also begin gradually with the online beginner course "First Touch". The main thing is your willingness to try and enjoy the process.

2.question: What should I bring to class?
2.answer: Wear comfortable clothes that let you move freely, and bring socks, knee pads, a bottle of water, and heels (if you have them).

3.question: Can I join in the middle of a month or course?
3.answer: If you want to join in the middle of the month, message Anna directly and she will advise when it is best to join new material. Links to her Instagram and Telegram are available in the "Contacts" section.

4.question: Is Frame Up right for me if I feel shy or afraid to move?
4.answer: Frame Up helps you open up naturally. Classes are held in a safe atmosphere where every woman feels support and respect. Shyness usually fades after the first sessions.

5.question: What is the difference between offline and online classes?
5.answer: Offline gives you group energy, live emotions and personal corrections. Online gives flexibility, comfort at home and learning at your own pace. Both formats bring real results.

6.question: What skill levels are available?
6.answer: There are groups for beginners, intermediate dancers and students who want to go deeper into technique and performance. I will help you choose the right level.

7.question: Can I train if I am not flexible?
7.answer: Flexibility is a skill that can be developed. Frame Up gently helps you open your body, improve mobility and feel more feminine.

8.question: Can I attend a trial class?
8.answer: Yes, you can attend a trial class for only 70 PLN in the offline beginner or continuing groups. Registration is available here:

9.question: Is Frame Up suitable for any age?
9.answer: Absolutely. Frame Up is about femininity, confidence and joy of movement, not age limits.

1.title: Lesson 1: Footwork fundamentals
1.description: We start with the basics of foot placement, both in heels and without heels. You learn to feel support, distribute body weight and stay stable in every movement. This is the foundation of body flow and expression.

2.title: Lesson 2: Living body — waves and spine
2.description: We open the body to flow. You explore soft waves, spinal mobility and torso control. You learn to connect breath with movement so the dance feels alive, fluid and sensual.

3.title: Lesson 3: Legs — en l'air, swings, kicks
3.description: We develop leg strength and expression. You master core elements and learn to execute them technically, clearly and with character. We focus on lines, amplitude and control.

4.title: Lesson 4: Performance — gaze and emotion
4.description: Dance is not only technique, but also story. You learn to work with performance quality: gaze, facial expression and inner state. How to convey emotion, engage the viewer and feel confident on stage and in class.

5.title: Lesson 5: Putting it all into choreography
5.description: We combine everything you have learned into your first full choreography. You dance, feel and enjoy. This is the point where technique becomes art and movement becomes personal style.

hero.subtitle: Discover yourself in Frame Up style
hero.description: Learn to dance beautifully, boldly and sensually in an atmosphere of freedom and feminine strength.

bio.1: I am Anna Strok, a professional dancer and teacher with many years of teaching experience and a clear artistic style.
bio.2: I am the creator and organizer of Total Strip Weekend in Minsk, the largest frame up strip and high heels championship in Belarus, which gathered hundreds of dancers and became an important event for the dance community.

quote.1: Today I develop Frame Up in Poland: I lead groups where women open up through movement, and I continue to learn from European masters to grow together with my students.
quote.2: My goal is to strengthen Frame Up culture and inspire women to be bold, free and expressive by creating a space where each woman can feel her strength, beauty and creative energy.

telegram.text: No extra platforms — the whole drop lives in one place, right after the payment.

payment.title: Pay from any country
payment.text:
You can pay by Visa / Mastercard, via BLIK, or with Google/Apple Pay from any country, including Belarus.

Available currencies: PLN and EUR. If your card is in another currency, your bank will automatically convert the amount.
